rule.name: HttpWithoutTimeout
rule.message: Give the call a deadline: HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)) for java.net.http, setConnectTimeout and setReadTimeout on an HttpURLConnection, setDefaultRequestConfig(RequestConfig.custom().setResponseTimeout(...)) on the Apache client builder, connectTimeout and readTimeout on a JAX-RS ClientBuilder, or OkHttp, which sets timeouts by default. This HTTP call has no timeout, so a server that never answers hangs it for good.
